lines: Chaand nikle kisi jaanib teri zebai ka
couplets.en: May the moon of your beauty rise somewhere.

lines: Rang badle kisi surat shab-e-tanhai ka
couplets.en: May this lonely night somehow change its hue.

Once more, O healer of hearts stricken by love.

lines: Koi waada, koi iqraar masihai ka
couplets.en: Give us a promise, some word that we might yet be healed.

lines: Saaz-o-saamaan baham pahuncha hai ruswai ka
couplets.en: Everything is in place for our disgrace.
